title: Greeting Formatter
learning_objectives: Define a function with a default argument
Return a value instead of printing it
hints: Start with `name = name.strip()`; remember strip returns a new string.
An empty string is falsy, so `if not name:` detects it.
Build the answer with `f"Hello, {name.title()}!"` and `return` it.

failure_feedback.advice: Call `.strip()` before `.title()` and keep the result in a variable.
Check for emptiness *after* stripping, not before.
`.title()` also lowercases the remaining letters — use it rather than `.capitalize()` on the first letter only.
